_comment: Registers the todo app in the platform catalog. Apply with:
or POST it to /api/resources. The whole batch is created in one
transaction, in dependency order, so the application may reference the
Ids are derived from name: 'todo app' -> 'todo-app'. Keep the names as
they are or the dependency and wiring ids below stop matching.
INFRASTRUCTURE IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. See register-infrastructure.md —
the Postgres module requires a @secure() admin password, and there is
currently no way to give it one without baking it into the ARM template.

secretSets.name: todo database
secretSets.description: The PostgreSQL credential the todo app connects with. Each tenant supplies its own value; it is written to that tenant's own Key Vault and cannot be read back by the platform.

applications.name: todo app
applications.description: FastAPI + PostgreSQL todo service. Reads its database credential from a Kubernetes Secret rather than from its own values.
applications.values:
image:
  repository: cortexcpacr6hy6uurw.azurecr.io/images/todo-app
imagePullSecrets:
  - name: cortex-registry
database:
  host: REPLACE_ME.postgres.database.azure.com
  port: 5432
  name: todos
  user: todoadmin
  sslMode: require
